title: Harden-Hayes earns MVP as Sporting hold off Benfica in Mother's Day thriller to claim third Taca Hugo dos Santos
description: Sporting CP captured their third Taca Hugo dos Santos with a nerve-shredding 79-77 victory over rivals SL Benfica at the Pavilhao Multiusos de Gondomar on Sunday, composure from the free-throw line in the dying seconds securing the Leoes' second trophy of the 2025-26 season in front of 1,067 fans. The final was a fitting spectacle for a special occasion â€” played on Dia da Mae (Mother's Day), the pre-game introductions saw each player presented alongside the name of their mother in a touching tribute that set the tone for an emotional afternoon.
